name: File Picker
description: File selection surface (dropzone, tile or compact trigger) with validation, a concurrent upload queue and the FileUploadRow list — list or grid layout, caller-keyed groups, per-file icons.

fields.background: ThemedColor? - tile fill; null = no fill
fields.borderColor: ThemedColor? - tile border; null = input token

notes: Platform file picking and drag intake are caller-supplied (`pick`, `dropTargetBuilder`): the old `web`/`cross_file`/dart:html adapters are gone.
`FileUploadDragDropOptions` / `FileUploadTileOptions` / `FileUploadMobileOptions` collapse to one `FileUploadVariant` enum with flat arguments.
The old row widget `FileItem` is `FileUploadRow` (the value type keeps the name). The row, its theme, the items view and the upload controller live in `primitives/file_value`.

`FileIconProvider` is replaced by the `FileUpload.iconBuilder` callback; grid layout and caller-keyed grouping are restored on `FileUpload` (`layout`, `gridColumns`, `groupKey`, `groupHeaderBuilder`).
